claim: A lifelong resident of Smithtown who has lived and worked in the 2nd Senate District his whole life
finding: Born in Smithtown and lives in St. James (Town of Smithtown); his 2021 swearing-in release calls him a lifelong district resident.

claim: Member and leader of Plumbers Local Union #200 for over 39 years
finding: He is a longtime Local 200 business agent (since 2003). But 2020 coverage and the Suffolk GOP announcement said he had been a member for about 25 years, and his Senate bio now says over 43. The figures don't reconcile.

claim: Manages over $250 million in union benefit funds
finding: SCWA's reappointment release describes him managing $250 million in pension, welfare and annuity funds as Local 200 business agent.

claim: Oversees the protection of over 1,300 workers
finding: No public record of the local's membership count was found.

claim: Served 25 years on Local 200's apprenticeship program board
finding: Repeated in his Senate bio, which is also self-reported. No independent record found.

claim: 2019 Order Sons of Italy Golden Lion "Labor Leader of the Year" and PBA Columbia 2012 Labor Leader of the Year
finding: Repeated in his Senate bio; no independent record found.

claim: Serves on the Suffolk County Water Authority board
finding: He was appointed in 2014 and reappointed to a second five-year term. The site lists the role as current with no dates.

claim: Father raising two daughters with his wife Terry
Through the Smithtown Advisory Board, helped secure millions in state funding (with Sen. Flanagan) for sewers in Smithtown, Kings Park and St. James
finding: His specific role isn't documented; the page gives no amount or year.
